name: shipit
description: Spec-driven development for any repo. `init` detects your stack, commands, layers and tests from evidence; `plan` writes a contract in your checkout (parallel worktrees are opt-in); `implement` executes and verifies it; `handoff` is the only skill that touches git, GitHub, or your tracker.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement and deliver work under a contract generated from your own repo
interface.longDescription: shipit detects your conventions instead of assuming them. `init` reads the repository once and writes a contract at `.sdd/`; `plan`, `implement`, `pr-fix` and `handoff` all work from that contract, so nothing in the plugin needs to know your framework. Parallel worktrees are opt-in, and git, GitHub and tracker writes happen only in `handoff`.
defaultPrompt: Run shipit init on this repo.
